rules.name: debian/ packaging directory present
rules.remediation: If shipping a Debian/Ubuntu package, place packaging recipes under debian/.

rules.name: RPM .spec file present
rules.remediation: RPM packaging expects a top-level <pkg>.spec file (or one under rpm/).

rules.name: snapcraft.yaml present
rules.remediation: If shipping a Snap, the canonical manifest is snapcraft.yaml or snap/snapcraft.yaml.

rules.name: data/ packaging metadata directory present
rules.remediation: AppStream / desktop metadata conventionally lives under data/<app-id>.metainfo.xml + data/<app-id>.desktop.
